title: "Pump not initialized, profile not Set!" error announcement every 4 minutes
symptom: After switching to a new Samsung phone and reinstalling AAPS and xDrip, the system reports a "Pump not initialized, profile not set!" error every 4-5 minutes, even though BG, insulin, carbs, basal %, and closed loop appear to work. The pump shows basal rate at 90% instead of the 100% that AAPS reports as set.
cause: The user was running an outdated version of AAPS (3.0.0.2-219bdba21) and AAPS was busy syncing with Nightscout, receiving many "_Pump not initialized, profile not set!_" note events.
fix: Update to the latest AAPS release (3.1.0) and update the Nightscout profile, then reactivate the profile. The user confirmed that creating the new version and updating the Nightscout profile resolved the problem.
evidence_quote: According to the logs - You are running an outdated version of AAPS (3.0.0.2-219bdba21): suggest updating to latest release 3.1.0 - AAPS was busy syncing with NS, receiving lots of "_Pump not initialized, profile not set!_" note events. Wait for NS sync is done then check your profile and reactivate.
